description: Nigeria - Kaduna Electricity Distribution Company Service Area Nightlights Dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by  Earth Observations Group (World Bank Group). Data collected as input to the geospatial least-cost plan for universal electricity access by 2030 developed as part of the ESMAP funded World Bank Nigeria Electricity Access Project (NEAP). The dataset covers the service area for the Kaduna Electricity Distribution Company (KEDCO) Nigeria. Coverage: Nigeria. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
